High-level Nim wrapper for Pebble Wakeup API.

Provides scheduled wakeup functionality to launch the app at a specific time.

Imports

../ffi

Procs

proc cancel(wakeupId: WakeupId) {.inline, ...raises: [], tags: [], forbids: [].}
Cancel a scheduled wakeup. Equivalent to C function wakeup_cancel(wakeup_id). 
proc cancelAll() {.inline, ...raises: [], tags: [], forbids: [].}
Cancel all scheduled wakeups. Equivalent to C function wakeup_cancel_all(). 
proc getLaunchEvent(wakeupId: ptr WakeupId; cookie: ptr int32): bool {.inline,
    ...raises: [], tags: [], forbids: [].}
Get the wakeup event that launched the app. Equivalent to C function wakeup_get_launch_event(wakeup_id, cookie). Returns true if the app was launched by a wakeup event. 
proc query(wakeupId: WakeupId; timestamp: ptr time_t): bool {.inline,
    ...raises: [], tags: [], forbids: [].}
Query information about a scheduled wakeup. Equivalent to C function wakeup_query(wakeup_id, timestamp). Returns true if the wakeup exists. 
proc schedule(timestamp: time_t; cookie: int32; notifyIfMissed: bool): WakeupId {.
    inline, ...raises: [], tags: [], forbids: [].}
Schedule a wakeup at the given timestamp. Equivalent to C function wakeup_schedule(timestamp, cookie, notify_if_missed). Returns a wakeup ID, or a negative error code on failure.

Subscribe to wakeup events. Equivalent to C function wakeup_service_subscribe(handler).
